name: @disco/pi-kernel
description: Disco Pi Build Kernel — the inner-loop sidecar that embeds Pi with no built-in tools, in-memory auth/session, emitting a JSON line-protocol event stream over stdio (Disco Pi Build Kernel Campaign, EPIC B / PR B1).

scripts.preinstall: node -e "if(process.env.npm_config_ignore_scripts!=='true'){console.error('@disco/pi-kernel: install MUST run with --ignore-scripts (campaign \u00a71.2 — never run dependency lifecycle scripts). Use: npm run setup, or npm install --ignore-scripts');process.exit(1)}"
